allcase_definition: all regions/all studies; Dice=1 for absent reference and empty prediction, else 0 for absent reference
bootstrap: paired patient-cluster resampling within fold; conditional on stored fits
clinical_estimand: equal-fold mean of study-wise positive-GT region-macro Dice

fold_completion.boundary: Missing folds of existing comparisons; retrospective extension, not new prospective confirmation.

normalization.boundary: Full-cohort bf16 primary; matched batch-one bf16/fp32 sensitivity on two fixed patients per fold. No isolated-channel causal attribution or normalization-placement retraining.
